title: The 24 V fault without a ball: the pre-feed check, and the trip with a 1.3-1.6 ms pair

checks.check: (a) within 100 ms of the first eRPM read above the limit
(b) trip latched on a 1.45 ms pair

notes: The eRPM never reaches the 24 V no-load (~21,000 rpm): the ramp passes the limit (11,616 rpm) a fifth of a second in and the turret is SAFE three telemetry reads later.
